answer: Any operator may flag a suspect identity by staking 100,000 POA, and every identity posts a 100,000 POA glacier bond at registration. A raven review at epoch end compares the flagged identity against the reef registry; when two trace to one operator, both lose rewards of about 258,000 POA each, their bonds burn, and the rewards pass to the operator who flagged them. Running five fakes risks 1,790,000 POA — 500,000 POA bonds plus 1,290,000 POA rewards — while a wrong flag costs the flagging operator 100,000 POA.
